sentences.text: The documents do not state a gold-loan FAQ pre-payment percentage.
The Gold Loan FAQ evidence only identifies the FAQ and its last updated date, and it does not give any pre-payment charge percentage.

The in-force UCB directions say that for cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and that the applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement.

missing.searched: Gold Loan FAQ, pre-payment charges / percentage
